work.headline: Turning complex data into dependable business processes.
work.intro: Representative examples are described without confidential business details.

items.title: Historical Data Reconstruction
items.text: Reconstructed first-time-exhibitor history dating to 1965 by reconciling NetForum records against archived spreadsheets and resolving incomplete, conflicting, and ambiguous entries.
items.result: Established a defensible historical record for reporting and migration instead of carrying legacy inconsistencies into the new system.

items.title: Migration Reporting & Data Quality Controls
items.text: Rebuilt reporting logic during the move from NetForum to Nimble AMS on Salesforce, identifying invalid orders and test records, updating commission reporting, and defining exclusion rules.
items.result: Preserved continuity for business reporting while preventing known data issues from distorting production outputs.

items.title: Legacy Workflow Integration
items.text: Used Power Query to map exhibitor booth-space reports from Nimble AMS into the legacy format required by a Microsoft Access workflow that generated booth-selection PDFs for event operations. Traced the Access logic, resolved compatibility issues, and documented its business rules.
items.result: Kept a business-critical event workflow operational during the system transition while creating the mapping and documentation needed for future modernization.

items.title: Cross-Functional Reporting & Audience Operations
items.text: Own recurring and ad hoc reporting for sales, marketing, operations, and leadership, and build SQL-driven audience segments in iPost Enterprise. Translate requests into query logic, validate exclusions, and deliver outputs teams can use.
items.result: Support ongoing decisions and campaigns with repeatable reporting, cleaner targeting, and clearly communicated results.

experience.headline: Experience across data, software, and quality assurance.

items.text: Own recurring and ad hoc reporting for sales, marketing, operations, and leadership. Support the transition from a legacy business system to Salesforce through data validation, report development, migration testing, audience segmentation, troubleshooting, field configuration, formulas, and process documentation.

Built SQL and Python tools, ETL workflows, internal automation, data-transfer processes, and user-facing applications for structured operational workflows. Designed the supporting data logic and interfaces to make those processes more repeatable, usable, and easier to maintain.

roles.text: Moved into paid development support after beginning as a volunteer contributor. Participated in internal development boards and tested live-service updates before public beta release. Performed regression testing, reproduced defects, validated workflows and data, and documented findings for developers.
Tested game systems, reproduced technical issues, validated data consistency, and documented defects. Earned additional access and responsibility through consistent and reliable contributions.

about.headline: I bridge business needs, data, and technical systems.
text: My background spans quality assurance, software development, and data operations. QA taught me to investigate issues methodically and document what I found; software development added experience with databases, automation, and system logic. I now apply that foundation to reporting, data quality, and business processes.

I do my best work when data is inconsistent, a workflow is unclear, or a system is changing. I like turning those situations into reliable outputs, documented rules, and processes other people can maintain.
I am continuing to deepen my ownership of Salesforce-based reporting, automation, and marketing audience architecture.
